Questions

Something missing? Write to arif@onehuman.ai.

How is this different from Cloudflare or bot protection?

Bot protection works at the door, before login. An AI agent working for your user comes in with the user's own login, so the door lets it in. OneHuman works after login, at each action.

Isn't this my customer's problem?

Their security tools only cover the laptops they manage. Contractors, personal devices and personal AI accounts reach your product directly. You are the only place that sees every session of every customer, and their security reviews will ask you how you control AI agents. In August 2026 a US appeals court held that, under the anti-hacking law, the person using an AI agent is the one who accesses a site, not the agent's maker. Keeping agents out through the courts is harder now, so the control has to be in your product. Amazon v. Perplexity →

Will real users notice it?

Rarely. In our own tests, 2 of 397 human clicks were read as a program. When OneHuman is not sure, it says "unknown", never "agent", and a person can always confirm with a passkey. How we measured →

Can we try it before we decide?

Yes, with a free 30-day AI agent report. OneHuman watches your app in watch-only mode and blocks nothing, then shows which AI agents logged in as your customers, what they touched and what it would have protected. Get the free report →

Does it run on our own servers?

Yes, fully on-premises: your servers, your database, and no data leaves them. If you connect the portal, it receives decision records only, never page content, names or IP addresses. Trust & privacy →
